_meta.description: 200 response for PUT /api/tesla/vehicles/{vehicleId}/service-window with a null body (MYR-316, CORRECTED by MYR-362) — the owner CLEARED their expected-back entry, so the OWNER COLUMN this endpoint echoes is null. Clearing is an ordinary write (200 + null echo), never a validation failure and never a separate DELETE verb; §7.16 accepts four spellings for it (absent key, explicit null, empty/whitespace string, empty body). The key is `expectedEndAt`, the same key as the happy path — the old fixture's `serviceEstimatedEndAt` is a key §7.16 never emits. Note the null says nothing about the RESOLVED window: if Tesla's service_data.service_etc exists it keeps winning under COALESCE and the next §7.0/§7.1 read will still carry an instant.
